contract.reregister_during_delivery: A listener can unregister and re-register another listener while an event is being delivered
contract.current_event_continuity: The active delivery sequence remains successful after the unregister and re-register mutation
contract.delivery_order: Listeners continue receiving the active event in the observed registration order
contract.registry_update: The listener registry reflects the re-registration without creating a duplicate entry
contract.duplicate_prevention: Re-registering the same plugin and callback does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.subsequent_delivery: The re-registered listener remains available for subsequent events
contract.registry_stability: Re-registration during emit does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after re-registration during delivery
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister, register, and emit operations require the events permission
